Subject: Reminder: Client Confidentiality Policy

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to remind everyone about the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality regarding our clients.

Recently, it was brought to my attention that client details were shared inappropriately. Please remember that sharing any client information with unauthorized individuals, including family members, is strictly against company policy.

Let’s all ensure that client data remains secure and is only discussed within the appropriate professional context.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
